g' is not an independent input. It is fixed by Delta a_mu through Eq. (6): Delta a_mu = g'^2/(4 pi^2) I(r), with r = (m_Zp/m_mu)^2.

The coupling is then g' = 2 pi sqrt(Delta a_mu / I), written as a formula in every term.
The coefficients of all terms in L are +g' for L_mu-charged fields (charge +1, including chi) and -g' for L_tau-charged fields, as in Eq. (3).
